title: You're not fully booked. You're fully rented.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props (no key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash). Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 (1080x1350). No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B — scene/organic. Slides 1,3,4,5 are pure AI photos. Slides 2 & 6 are DEVICE-COMPOSITE: generate a photo where an iPhone 17 (s2) or a laptop (s6) has a BLANK PURE-WHITE screen, then Claude composites the saved booking-app UI onto that screen (screen.app tells which). When Kim sends each device photo, Claude reads the 4 screen-corner coordinates and sets `screen.quad` to composite it in perspective. Drop photos into assets/scene-01/ as s1,s2,s3,s4,s5,s6 .png.

slides.title: Every booking feels like a ((win)).
slides.body: Until you count how little of it you actually keep.
slides.imagePrompt: Camera pulled BACK (not a tight close-up). Two hands holding an iPhone 17 (Dynamic Island, thin bezels) UP in the TOP portion of the frame at a warm walnut cafe table, morning light, a flat-white and a small plant softly out of focus to the sides. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: the phone occupies only the UPPER ~60% of the image; the LOWER 40% is a clean, empty, softly-shadowed dark walnut table surface (nothing on it) reserved for text. The phone is FRONT-ON and its screen is a solid PURE-WHITE rectangle (#FFFFFF) — completely blank, no UI, no reflections, fully unobstructed by fingers, all four screen corners visible. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.title: ==25%== of that win was never yours.
slides.body: The middleman took his cut before the money ever reached you.
slides.imagePrompt: Modern editorial still-life, slight overhead angle: a guest's hand tapping a sleek matte-black contactless card on a minimalist modern payment terminal at a cream-and-walnut hotel reception, warm directional light, a small potted plant softly out of focus behind. Contemporary and premium. LEAVE THE TOP THIRD a calm darker surface for text; hand + terminal lower-right. NO cash, no coins, no old objects. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]

slides.title: The guest searched your name.
slides.body: The platform just ~~introduced~~ charged you for a guest you already had.

Golden interior light, lush plants, walnut and cream, a soft green neon accent by the desk. LEAVE THE BOTTOM THIRD calm and darker for text; subject centred, upper-mid. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
